declarationDays.source: Cabinet Decision No. 109 of 2023 on beneficial owner procedures, https://www.uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/2314/download ; Boasis research, licence lifecycle, sections 1a and 6 (content/library/dubai-mainland/ubo.md): the declaration within 60 days of licensing

updateDays.source: Cabinet Decision No. 109 of 2023 on beneficial owner procedures, https://www.uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/2314/download ; Boasis research, licence lifecycle, sections 1a and 6 (content/library/dubai-mainland/ubo.md): each change filed within 15 days

registrationTimelineFrom.source: FTA Decision No. 3 of 2024 on the registration timeline for corporate tax, https://tax.gov.ae/Datafolder/Files/Legislation/FTA%20Decision%20No.%203%20of%202024%20on%20Registration%20Timeline%20for%20Corporate%20Tax%20-%20For%20publishing.pdf and https://tax.gov.ae/en/media.centre/news/federal.tax.authority.issues.new.decision.on.specified.timeframes.for.corporate.tax.registration.aspx : a juridical person incorporated on or after 1 March 2024 registers within 3 months of incorporation; the deadlines for persons incorporated before that day all fell in 2024

registrationMonths.source: FTA Decision No. 3 of 2024 on the registration timeline for corporate tax, https://tax.gov.ae/Datafolder/Files/Legislation/FTA%20Decision%20No.%203%20of%202024%20on%20Registration%20Timeline%20for%20Corporate%20Tax%20-%20For%20publishing.pdf and https://tax.gov.ae/en/media.centre/news/federal.tax.authority.issues.new.decision.on.specified.timeframes.for.corporate.tax.registration.aspx

returnMonths.source: FTA news, returns and payment within nine months from the end of the tax period, https://tax.gov.ae/en/media.centre/News/federal.tax.authority.urges.submission.of.corporate.tax.returns.and.settlement.of.corporate.tax.liabilities.within.nine.months.from.the.end.of.the.tax.period.aspx ; first tax period of 6 to 18 months, FTA Public Clarification CTP003, https://tax.gov.ae/en/media.centre/news/Corporate.Tax.Public.Clarification.on.the.First.Tax.Period.aspx

firstTaxPeriodMonths.source: FTA Public Clarification CTP003 on the first tax period, https://tax.gov.ae/en/media.centre/news/Corporate.Tax.Public.Clarification.on.the.First.Tax.Period.aspx : a juridical person's first tax period is its first financial year, which can run from 6 to 18 months from incorporation (onboarding v2 section I, confirmed)

lateRegistrationConsequence.source: FTA waiver of penalties page, https://tax.gov.ae/en/about.fta/waiver.of.penalties.aspx , and FTA news of 14 May 2026, https://tax.gov.ae/en/media.centre/news/fta.expects.number.of.beneficiaries.from.corporate.tax.late.registration.penalty.waiver.initiative.to.rise.to.91000.aspx : an administrative penalty applies for registering for corporate tax late (onboarding v2 section 8, FTA confirmed). The amount is left out by design.

qfzpAuditedAccounts.source: Ministerial Decision No. 84 of 2025 on audited financial statements, https://mof.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Ministerial-Decision-No.-84-of-2025-on-Audited-Financial-Statements.pdf : every Qualifying Free Zone Person prepares audited financial statements (onboarding v2 section I, confirmed). The audit due date is not sourced yet.

lateRegistrationWaiver.source: Unverified, not a live rule. FTA waiver page https://tax.gov.ae/en/about.fta/waiver.of.penalties.aspx and FTA news of 14 May 2026 https://tax.gov.ae/en/media.centre/news/fta.expects.number.of.beneficiaries.from.corporate.tax.late.registration.penalty.waiver.initiative.to.rise.to.91000.aspx describe a waiver when the first return is filed within 7 months of the end of the first tax period; whether it is still in force in September 2026 is unverified. Recheck before launch.

mandatoryThresholdAed.source: FTA VAT registration page, https://tax.gov.ae/en/taxes/Vat/vat.topics/registration.for.vat.aspx : mandatory when taxable supplies and imports passed AED 375,000 over the previous 12 months, or are expected to pass it in the next 30 days

voluntaryThresholdAed.source: FTA VAT registration page, https://tax.gov.ae/en/taxes/Vat/vat.topics/registration.for.vat.aspx : voluntary above AED 187,500

expectedWithinDays.source: FTA VAT registration page, https://tax.gov.ae/en/taxes/Vat/vat.topics/registration.for.vat.aspx : expected to pass the mandatory threshold in the next 30 days

returnDays.source: Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017, Art. 64, via u.ae, https://u.ae/en/information-and-services/finance-and-investment/taxation/vat/filing-a-tax-return-for-vat : the return and payment are due by the 28th day after the tax period ends

applicationWindowDays.source: Unverified at article level, not a live rule. VAT Executive Regulation, https://tax.gov.ae/Datafolder/Files/Legislation/Executive%20Regulation%20of%20Federal%20Decree%20Law%20No%208%20of%202017%20-%20Publish%20-%2004%2010%202024.pdf , is said to give 30 days to apply after the threshold is passed; the article text was not read

residenceRenewalMonths.source: ICP residence renewal service, https://icp.gov.ae/en/services-details/?serviceid=64afe3c1035448005bd52e66 : passport valid for no less than 6 months
